R01.attention: Method. Rates are Freddie Mac's weekly survey via FRED, checked against the Optimal Blue index since 2017. A drop counts when the monthly average falls at least 1 point from a peak before rising 1 point from its low. Costs are HMDA loan-level data from 2018 to 2025: originated refinances, first lien, 30-year term.
R01.why: States 0.5-point cut pays back in 36 months; small loan needs more.
